nodes.label: Next.js Breaking-Change Guidance
nodes.source_location: This is NOT the Next.js you know
nodes.rationale: The installed Next.js version may differ from prior knowledge, so agents must consult the package-local documentation before changing code.

nodes.label: Mode-Agnostic Game Engine
nodes.rationale: One engine serves all games and modes so daily, practice, and future endless play share lifecycle, selection, scoring, and board logic.

nodes.label: Daily Mode
nodes.rationale: Daily is a bounded, comparable ten-round challenge with three lives and a frozen puzzle set shared by all players.

nodes.label: Practice Mode
nodes.rationale: Practice remains unbounded even after misses because terminating it would make persistent score, streak, and history appear to reset.

nodes.label: Completed Run State
nodes.rationale: COMPLETED is the only terminal state that writes leaderboard results.

nodes.label: Abandoned Run State
nodes.rationale: An abandoned daily run scores nothing, preventing players from rerolling an unfavorable start.

nodes.label: Server-Authoritative Game State
nodes.rationale: The server withholds pending answers and derives round index, stage, attempts, and score to prevent client-side cheating and stale-round mutation.

nodes.label: Earned Audio Byte-Range Prefix
nodes.rationale: Each stage receives only its earned prefix, so the client cannot scrub into unrevealed audio.

nodes.label: CBR MP3 Reveal Asset
nodes.rationale: CBR MP3 is used because a truncated MP3 remains decodable while a truncated MP4 does not.

nodes.label: Content-Addressed Audio Storage
nodes.rationale: Checksum-based keys avoid leaking the song answer through human-readable storage URLs.

nodes.label: Attempt Idempotency
nodes.rationale: A retried mutation returns its stored result instead of consuming a second attempt.

nodes.label: Run Row Locking
nodes.rationale: SELECT FOR UPDATE plus a version increment prevents concurrent submits from both advancing the reveal ladder.

nodes.label: Run Mutation Token
nodes.rationale: A hashed per-run bearer token is required on mutations because possession of a player cookie alone must not authorize changing another run.

nodes.label: Versioned Scoring Formula
nodes.rationale: Scoring is pinned per run so rebalancing cannot rewrite historical scores; XP stays flatter than competitive score to provide steady progression.

nodes.label: Within-Run Popularity Difficulty Curve
nodes.rationale: Difficulty comes from catalog popularity and hook position rather than user-selectable tiers, preserving leaderboard comparability.

nodes.label: Popularity-Window Puzzle Selection
nodes.rationale: Selection samples around a target popularity, excludes run repeats and recent player history, and widens the window when the catalog is thin.

nodes.label: Telemetry-Based Popularity Self-Tuning
nodes.rationale: Observed early-solve rate is blended gradually into popularity while the seed remains unchanged, making retuning stable and reversible.

nodes.label: Frozen Daily Challenge
nodes.rationale: A fixed platform timezone and one pre-generated ordered puzzle set keep the daily challenge comparable and recoverable.

nodes.label: Guest-to-User Claim Transaction
nodes.rationale: A unique guest claim and one transaction make migration of runs, stats, history, and leaderboard entries idempotent and one-way.

nodes.label: Leaderboard Finalization Writes
nodes.rationale: Only ranked completed runs write boards; rank is derived on read rather than treated as durable truth.

nodes.label: Ingest Dry Run
nodes.rationale: Dry-run performs cutting and encoding without persistence so invalid hook positions are caught before uploads or database writes.

nodes.label: Idempotent Catalog Upsert
nodes.source_location: What the pipeline does per track
nodes.rationale: The stable source tuple updates metadata and hook placement in place while preserving accumulated play telemetry.

nodes.label: hookStartMs Difficulty Lever
nodes.rationale: Hand-selecting the hook position determines whether the 200ms first reveal is recognizable instead of silence or an unhelpful intro.

nodes.label: seedPopularity Catalog Ranking
nodes.rationale: Popularity is a relative recognizability rank that must be spread across the target range to support a smooth ten-round difficulty ramp.

nodes.label: Storage Byte-Range Verification
nodes.rationale: Storage must honor Range requests or stage one would accidentally disclose the entire seven-second clip.
